establishment_id.title: Establishment ID
establishment_id.description: Official City of Toronto establishment identifier.

establishment_name.title: Establishment Name
establishment_name.description: Food establishment (business) name as published in the public inspection record.

address.title: Address
address.description: Street address of the establishment, as published in the public inspection record.

postal_code.title: Postal Code
postal_code.description: Canadian postal code extracted from the published address, when present.

status.title: Status
status.description: Inspection outcome assigned by Toronto Public Health: Pass, Conditional Pass, or Closed.

latitude.title: Latitude
latitude.description: Latitude of the establishment, when provided by the source.

longitude.title: Longitude
longitude.description: Longitude of the establishment, when provided by the source.

infraction_count.title: Infraction Count
infraction_count.description: Number of infractions recorded at this inspection (0 for a clean inspection).

infractions.title: Infractions
infractions.description: Infraction detail for this inspection: category, detail, severity as published, and normalized severity_level (Minor, Significant, or Crucial).

observation.title: Observation
observation.description: Inspector observation summary published with the inspection, when present.

outcome_date.title: Outcome Date
outcome_date.description: Date of a prosecution outcome, when one is recorded; empty otherwise.

outcome_description.title: Outcome Description
outcome_description.description: Description of a prosecution outcome, when one is recorded; empty otherwise.

amount_fined.title: Amount Fined (CAD)
amount_fined.description: Fine amount in CAD when a prosecution outcome imposed one; null otherwise.

source_endpoint.title: Source Endpoint
source_endpoint.description: Official City of Toronto open-data page the records were retrieved from.

scraped_at.title: Retrieved At
scraped_at.description: UTC timestamp of when this Actor retrieved the record (ISO 8601).
